Overview

Laayoune is a city in Laâyoune-Sakia El Hamra with a population of 217,000. The largest city in Western Sahara, serving as a regional administrative and economic center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
